title: 3-Day Peloponnese & Ancient Greece Tour
metaDescription: Discover Corinth, Mycenae, Epidaurus and Olympia on a 3-day mainland Greece journey through the archaeological heart of the ancient Peloponnese.

summary:
The 3-Day Olympia, Delphi & Corinth Tour is a fast-moving mainland route through the Peloponnese and central Greece, designed for travelers with limited time outside Athens. Cross the Corinth Canal before visiting Mycenae and Epidaurus, with time in the coastal town of Nafplio. The journey continues to Ancient Olympia and finishes at Delphi, linking several important sites from different periods of classical Greek history within three days.
This year-round itinerary involves consecutive touring rather than returning to Athens each evening. Selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, entrance fees, transfers and the scheduled sightseeing are included during the journey.

itinerary.title: Athens to Olympia
itinerary.text: Meet in the hotel lobby and depart for your 3-day Classical Greece Tour. Drive along the coastal road with a short stop at the Corinth Canal. Continue to the Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus and then to Nafplio for a short stop. Visit Mycenae and the Tomb of Agamemnon before continuing through Tripolis and Megalopolis to Olympia. Overnight in Olympia.

itinerary.title: Olympia to Delphi
itinerary.text: Morning visit to Ancient Olympia, including the Sanctuary of Olympian Zeus, Ancient Stadium, and the Archaeological Museum of Olympia. Continue via the Rio–Antirrio Bridge, passing through Nafpaktos and Itea before arriving in Delphi. Overnight in Delphi.

itinerary.title: Back to Athens
itinerary.text:
Morning visit to the Archaeological Site of Delphi and the Delphi Archaeological Museum. Continue through Arachova and drive via Levadia and Thebes back to Athens. Arrival in Athens around 18:30–19:00.
Accommodation in Athens before or after the tour is not included.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 3-Day Classical Mainland Tour?
faqs.a: The 3-Day Classical Mainland Tour covers Olympia and Delphi, two of Greece's most important archaeological sites. You will visit the birthplace of the Olympic Games and explore Delphi, the sacred sanctuary that was once considered the center of the ancient Greek world. The tour runs for 2 nights and 3 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 3-Day Classical Mainland Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €628 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, transportation between destinations, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: What are the main attractions included in the tour?
faqs.a: The tour includes the archaeological site of Olympia, home of the first Olympic Games, and Delphi, famous for the Sanctuary of Apollo, the ancient theater, stadium, and archaeological museum. Both sites are UNESCO World Heritage treasures and among Greece's most significant historical landmarks.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 2 nights at carefully selected hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near the attractions included in the itinerary.

faqs.q: Does the 3-Day Classical Mainland Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for travelers interested in Greece's ancient history and archaeology. It offers an excellent introduction to two of the country's most important classical sites in a short and well-organized itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through large archaeological sites and navigating some uneven terrain. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate throughout the tour.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Olympia and Delphi?
faqs.a: Olympia is famous as the birthplace of the Olympic Games and features ancient temples, training grounds, and one of Greece's finest archaeological museums. Delphi is renowned for the Sanctuary of Apollo, the Oracle of Delphi, breathtaking mountain scenery, and its remarkable archaeological museum.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 3-Day Classical Mainland Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 3-Day Classical Mainland Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, combine it with Athens or the Greek Islands, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
